title: Mysterious Circumstances (BBC)
paragraphs: A BBC Transcription Service package of half-hour thriller plays assembled from productions spanning many years. It is an anthology package rather than a single continuous cast or storyline.

Mysterious Circumstances is a BBC Transcription Service package, not one continuous domestic series. Research describes a 26-play half-hour package assembled from BBC productions made across decades, including plays first broadcast under other BBC titles or services.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Early source-production cluster (November 25, 1958 to December 24, 1963), Later source-production cluster (January 23, 1967 to January 30, 1978), and Late package-era production cluster (October 16, 1982 to 1989).

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Charles Lefeaux (producer and radio adaptor), Martin C. Webster (producer), Christopher Whelen (composer), Gordon House (director), Max Adrian (performer), Michael Hardwick (radio adaptor), and Michael Hordern (performer).

The stories often return to BBC Transcription Service mystery package, mystery and suspense, literary and dramatic adaptation, source productions regrouped from multiple BBC strands, supernatural and ghost story, and retribution, guilt and uncanny consequence.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes BBC Transcription Service Mysterious Circumstances package, Mystery Playhouse source productions regrouped, Cross-service BBC source origins, and Partial circulating preservation of a larger package.
